verdict.rationale: Luma offers a developer API with SDKs, a documentation site, and machine-readable docs (llms.txt and .md page versions), so this axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows an interactive API reference or runnable in-browser examples, and the OpenAPI/Swagger probe returned 404 on every candidate path. Docs and SDKs sit next to this capability but are not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
